description: Create a polished, on-brand Instagram hero image (square/portrait/reel-cover). The matching caption + hashtags are produced by the caption pipeline.

inputs.name: brand_style
inputs.default: modern, vibrant, clean typography, lifestyle photography aesthetic
inputs.description: Brand personality and visual style tags.

inputs.name: format
inputs.description: Post format: 1:1 feed square, 4:5 portrait, 9:16 Reels.

Optimize for Instagram aesthetics: clean, punchy, single focal point. Append style tags: {{brand_style}}, social media photography, highly detailed.
